sylvia-mgr: Quick check  proposing a comp-only adjustment (~9%) for an IC due to sustained customer impact. Any required evidence beyond the standard bullets?

people-ops: Standard pack works: manager justification + 3 impact bullets + 2 anonymized peer notes. For comp-only, call out retention risk and recent market signals.

sylvia-mgr: Retention risk noted. Do we need to attach offer comps if candidate got an external counter?

jamal-comp: Attach a redacted offer summary or note "counteroffer_received=yes" plus date. That helps justify >7-10% bumps. Also include proposed band percentile (midpoint +9%).

people-ops-bot: Form link: https://hr.redwood.com/forms/comp-only. Required fields: employee_id, manager, comp_rationale, funding_source, effective_date, backpay_yes_no.

payroll-bot: payroll_cutoff=1940012300 UTC for next retro pay. Submit before cutoff for May retro. Off-cycle runs possible but require payroll approval.

sylvia-mgr: Great  submitting now and will add the redacted offer. Thanks!
